en.title: ue in înșeuează (saddles)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong ue as found in the word înșeuează.

sections.title: The letters ue
paragraphs: The letters ue sound like /we/. Their main sound is heard in (înșeuează) /ɨn.ʃe.we̯aˈza/, which means saddles a horse. This combination makes one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Make a small tight circle with your lips. Glide smoothly into an open smile. Vibrate your vocal cords with your voice throughout the glide. You can feel your throat buzz with your fingers.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: These two letters sound like the sound /we̯/ within a single syllable, as in (leului) /ˈlew.luj/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn this glide into two slow vowels. Move quickly like the start of wet. Keep your lips tight at first.
